code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    for color in range(10):
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] == color]
        for i, (r1,c1) in enumerate(pts):
            for r2,c2 in pts[i+1:]:
                if abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1) and r2 != r1:
                    dr = 1 if r2>r1 else -1
                    dc = 1 if c2>c1 else -1
                    for k in range(1, abs(r2-r1)):
                        out[r1+dr*k][c1+dc*k] = color
    return out
'''
